Main concerns: scheduling/backpressure behavior under hot shards, KV-cache eviction compaction during bursts, reduced autoscaling headroom due to multi-tenant constraints in their on-prem sizing plan. Requested features from NovaNet: guaranteed burst capacity lanes, explicit queueing throttles, token-level latency SLO, and an A/B fallback route to a smaller cheaper model without state loss.
